messages:
maria: Heads up — after the RBAC role rotation this morning, SAST noise spiked on staging. New rule 'exec-path-injection' is firing across infra/, many hits in scripts/deploy.sh. Anyone else seeing a correlated change? :eyes:
sec-bot: Automated alert: SAST regression detected on staging (rule=exec-path-injection). 48 findings in last 10m. Scan run: kestrel-staging-scan-2026-03-21.
jeremy: I see the same in CI — kestrel-staging-scan failed consistently on the post-build checks. 12/12 jobs reported the rule.
sam: Could be related to the role rotation: if the service account lost KMS decrypt perms the build falls back to a file-based secret or template rendering path and that can trip SAST. Can you paste the failing snippet?
maria: Pasting minimal repro from the scan (redacted):
```
# infra/scripts/deploy.sh:45
exec $DEPLOY_BIN --config "$TMP_DIR/$CONFIG_FILE" || exit 1
```
SAST flagged the `exec $DEPLOY_BIN` usage as exec-path-injection. Grep across staging artifacts: `grep -R "exec \$DEPLOY_BIN" infra/ | wc -l` -> 31 hits.
alisha: I checked kube audit & IAM logs. At 11:02 UTC there was a KMS decrypt denied for `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/build-secrets` from the staging runner SA. Audit excerpt: 
```
protoPayload.methodName: "cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.access"
protoPayload.status.code: 7
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail: "staging-builder@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
```
That lines up with the window when the scans started failing.
sam: Yep that matches my hypothesis. When decrypt fails some of our build tasks fallback to writing a local temp secret file which changes the code path SAST inspects. We need 1) a remediation (restore KMS decrypt to the SA) and 2) an evidence bundle for compliance before we suppress alerts.
maria: Proposal: approve a 4-hour suppression for path `infra/scripts/*` on staging while we triage, with the exception requiring: KMS audit logs, exact commit range, and the role-binding change diff. Who can sign off quickly? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jeremy: Oncall can approve a short suppression. I can sign off for up to 4 hours if we get the evidence attached in the ticket and a rollback/mitigation plan. I'll also spin a canary to revert the role rotation in staging if we can't get KMS perms fixed in 15m.
sam: Prefer to fix SA binding instead of revert. I'll open a PR to infra-roles to re-add `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` for `staging-builder@...` and request an expedited review. Command I'm about to run in staging to rebind if approved: 
```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood --member="serviceAccount:staging-builder@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
```
maria: Good. For the compliance checklist, please attach: 
- KMS audit logs around the failure window (extract with `gcloud logging read`)
- The PR/commit that changed RBAC (link + diff)
- Pre/post scan artifact (kestrel-staging-scan-2026-03-21)
- Temporary suppression ticket + approver name
I'll update the secure-sdlc retro doc after resolution.
jeremy: I've opened a ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2345 and attached initial logs. Tagging it `scan:investigate` and `suppress-request`. I've also applied a 4hr suppression in staging for `infra/scripts/*` (automation confirmed). :white_check_mark:
sec-bot: Policy update: suppression `infra/scripts/*` @ staging created by jeremy — expires in 4h. Labels: scan:temporary-suppression, reason="KMS decrypt failure caused fallback path".
alisha: Rebinding done in staging (PR #402, merged). I can confirm `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"staging-builder@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" AND protoPayload.status.code=7" --limit=50` now shows the earlier denies but no new denies after merge.
sam: Thanks. Re-run full SAST nightly job to validate. I'll trigger a manual full-scan now and monitor for false positives.
maria: Thanks everyone — once the scan clears, remove the suppression and post the final scan summary to SEC-2345. Also let's add a preventive test to the premerge gating that simulates KMS deny to see if we can detect the fallback earlier. Adding as action item to the ticket. :memo:
jeremy: Agreed. Tagging security-review for a short postmortem tomorrow.
maria: Closing loop here — appreciate the quick ops.
